ops_incident_bot: INCIDENT ALERT for channel=chat-completions — rule=latency_p99_global fired at 2026-03-15T09:20:32Z :rotating_light:
Claire (oncall): saw the page, investigating. p99 spiked across multiple routes.
Claire (oncall): early signal: p95 stayed mostly stable (~320ms) but p99 jumped to ~2.1s for a ~7m window.
Ravi (eng-sre): thanks — can you paste the query IDs / example traces?
Claire (oncall): pasting top 3 traces:
```
trace_id=tx-99a1 route=chat/completions model=mistral-v1-chat latency=2140ms
trace_id=tx-99b2 route=chat/completions model=gpt-small latency=1870ms
trace_id=tx-99c3 route=chat/reply model=mistral-v1-chat latency=2060ms
```
Marta (eng-platform): hmm looks like cross-model impact, not just one model. Any infra errors?
Jun (infra): checking node metrics — no OOMs, a subset of GPU hosts showed elevated CPU host-side exec time (kernel scheduling delays). Putting link to host dashboard: https://dash.redwood/hosts/gpu-cluster/2026-03-15
Jun (infra): also saw a brief autoscaler glitch where burst pools didn't spin up for 90s.
Ravi (eng-sre): that explains the tail. For paging: ops_incident_bot paged on global p99 > 1200ms, which hit frequently because the global p99 lumps low-traffic routes with noisy tails. Need to reduce noise.
Claire (oncall): current mitigation in prod: temporarily widened fallback to light-weight model for non-critical routes and enabled route-level fallback for /chat/reply. That knocked p99 down to ~850ms after 3m.
Marta (eng-platform): good live mitigation. For long-term we should: 1) move from global p99 paging to per-route/per-model p99 2) add p95-based fast alerts for regressions 3) squelch duplicate pages for 10m on the same route/model.
Ravi (eng-sre): propose concrete thresholds (initial proposal):
- global: remove global p99 pager (keep as dashboard)
- per-route default p95 alert: 500ms (warning), p99 alert: 1400ms (page)
- high-sensitivity routes (e.g., /chat/interactive): p95=350ms, p99=900ms
- low-traffic experimental routes: p99 page at 3000ms, but with noise-filtering rules
Jun (infra): also propose introducing rolling-quantile smoothing (5-min rolling median + 95th) so single outliers from cold-cache loads don't immediately page.
Claire (oncall): can we get a short alert rule snippet to review?
Ravi (eng-sre): adding a sample snippet for alerting repo (YAML):
```
- name: chat_completions_per_route_p99
  expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="chat/completions"}[5m]) > {{ threshold_seconds }}
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "chat/completions p99 > {{ threshold_seconds }}s (per-route)"
    runbook: "/runbooks/latency-chat-completions"
  for: 2m
```
Marta (eng-platform): two quick asks: 1) add a label `model` to the metric series if not present, so we can split by model in alerts/dashboards; 2) create a per-model dashboard with histograms and rolling p50/p95/p99.
Claire (oncall): i can own the runbook edits during this shift. I'll add the mitigation checklist we used (fallback toggles, scale-up checklist, check autoscaler events).
Jun (infra): i'll create infra ticket to investigate autoscaler delay root cause — linking ticket infra-5429.
Ravi (eng-sre): action items from this thread:
- PR to alerts repo with per-route thresholds + smoothing (owner: Ravi) — target: today EOD
- Add `model` label to latency metric and update exporters (owner: Jun) — target: 3 business days
- New dashboard: per-model histograms + p95/p99 trend (owner: Marta) — target: 2 business days
- Runbook update with explicit fallback toggles and a handoff checklist (owner: Claire) — target: end of this oncall shift
- Post-incident review meeting to finalize threshold values (owners: Ravi/Marta) — schedule for tomorrow 10:30 PT
Marta (eng-platform): one more nit: let's not use identical p99 values for all models. e.g. small LMs often have lower tail variance so we can set stricter p99. I'll bring a per-model baseline table to the review.
Claire (oncall): handoff note for next oncall @Ravi — state: mitigations in place, pages disabled for global p99, per-route page rules proposed but not yet deployed, follow-ups assigned.
Ravi (eng-sre): ack — i'll pick this up for the rollout. For paging noise: suggest 10m de-dup window and low-frequency routes require 3 firing intervals before page.
ops_incident_bot: INCIDENT status changed: mitigated -> monitoring.
Claire (oncall): marking thread closed for now, will reopen if pages recur. Thanks all. :heart:
